title: Compile single-category character sets to a bare `CATEGORY` opcode
author: eendebakpt
body_preview: After gh-152033, `\d` outside a set compiles to a bare `CATEGORY` opcode with a fast `REPEAT_ONE` / `count` path. Such sets can compile to the same bare `CATEGORY` opcode (the negated form via the complementary category, `CH_NEGATE`),...

title: Speed up matching of case-insensitive character sets
author: eendebakpt
body_preview: # Feature or enhancement  ### Proposal:  A `REPEAT_ONE` over a case-insensitive character set — e.g. `[a-z]+` with `re.IGNORECASE` — does not use the fast `SRE(count)` path.
